interface.shortDescription: Health information navigation for cancer patients — not medical advice
interface.longDescription: CureWise is a health information navigation tool for people living with cancer. It helps users search public clinical trial listings from ClinicalTrials.gov, read and organize their own uploaded health documents, and run side-by-side informational comparisons across AI models. CureWise does not provide medical advice, diagnosis, or treatment recommendations and is not a substitute for consultation with a qualified healthcare professional.
capabilities: Search public clinical trial listings from ClinicalTrials.gov by keyword or NCT ID
Read and search personal health documents the user has uploaded
Compare AI-generated informational responses side-by-side (educational only)
